about_the_game:
2018.

A secret organization has completed the construction of a complex for space exploration, as well as for the development of technology to robotize humans for military purposes.

At this time, strange meteorites fell to Earth, and no one suspected that they contained something terrible inside.

2019.

The virus in the meteorites began to spread rapidly, taking over the mind and body of almost all people. Through this process, robotization broke out beyond the walls of the complex, threatening all of humanity.

It won't let me die...

Robotization: The Last Human - a first-person survival-horror game in which you have to survive in a world full of horrors. Be afraid of unknown creatures and lose your last hope for salvation.

Survive in this scary world where you are completely alone...

Immerse yourself in the story of Alex, the character you will play as. Fight with your sanity, save resources, create items, defend or escape, explore a variety of locations, trust no one.

Will you remain the last person who cares about everything?

You survived for a reason. Someone or something desired it. Someone or something sought to destroy humanity.

Survival

You will be able to find various items that will help you create things for defense, distraction, and healing. However, remember to conserve your resources - they will not be enough. To increase your ability to create items, you will need to find a workbench.

Combat System

It's not always possible to hide and run, so all that's left is to try to fight back. Find bricks, stones, bottles, sticks and pieces of pipes or create explosive devices from the resources you've collected. Use these opportunities only as your last chance to escape.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains scenes with dismemberment of the head (from first person),
dismembered bodies, meat, and blood.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Core 2 Quad Q8300 or similar from AMD | 4 cores
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 650 Ti or similar from AMD | 2 GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 9 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Specifications are for playing at 720p and 60 fps (Unstable, medium settings)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 or similar from AMD | 4 cores
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1650 SUPER or similar from AMD | 4 GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 9 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Specifications are for playing at 1080p and 60 fps (Ultra settings)
